integrity: Self-contained analytical proof with an independently implemented exact-rational finite diagnostic suite; finite checks are not a universal proof. No external independent audit or authorial priority guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Exact rank applies to pairs of analytic polynomials in the unweighted harmonic Bergman disk; it does not extend as stated to arbitrary rational symbols, coanalytic mixtures, or other measures. A potentially related 2013 article could be checked only through its abstract; unindexed equivalent results remain possible.
title: Exact Wronskian-degree rank law for polynomial harmonic Bergman commutators
